results.title: Record diesel prices drive UK inflation to 1-year high of 3.6% - CNBC
results.snippet: U.K. inflation rose to 3.6% in the 12 months to October, its highest level in a year, as fuel costs continued to rise. October's reading puts U.K. inflation at a one-year high. Britain's Office for National Statistics said the largest contributor to the rising inflation rate was motor fuel costs, which rose 33.2% year-on-year.
